OUR ROOTS

From the Nilgiris,
with a story to tell.

YARUVA is a modern expression inspired by the place we call home — the Nilgiris, Ooty, and the living heritage of the Baduga community.

It began with a simple thought: what we wear can express where we come from, while what we share at the table can keep us connected to it.

Our clothing helps you express yourself. Our tea brings you back to the feeling of home.

WEAR YOUR STORY. SIP YOUR ROOTS.
YARUVA LIFESTYLE

Wear your story.
Sip your roots.

Clothing for how you show up. Nilgiri tea for the moments that bring you back.

YARUVA TEA

Our small-scale tea line connects the brand to the Nilgiris through a simple everyday ritual — thoughtfully introduced alongside our core clothing and styling platform.
